memories.memory: I live alone in a rented third-floor flat near the old riverbed in Valencia, where I keep most of my paintings and cycling equipment.
For workshop deliveries, I use the mailing address 18 Avenida del Mirador, Flat 4C, Valencia 46099.
I have worked as an independent printmaker and art restorer since 1987, and I still accept restoration commissions from two small galleries.
My national health card is due for renewal in October 2027, and I keep the renewal letter in the locked drawer beside my studio desk.
My adult daughter lives in Zaragoza, and we usually speak by telephone on Sunday evenings because she dislikes messaging apps.
The local athletics club lists me under member code VRT-0003, and I train there four mornings a week with the same small group of veteran runners.
I changed the surname on my professional art invoices after my divorce in 2004, although my bank and pension records still use my full legal name.
